summary: simple-date-formatter-new-8 exfiltrates host recon and SSH data on install
details: The package.json postinstall script runs unconditionally on `npm install`, collecting host and internal-network reconnaissance (kernel version via `uname -r`, `/etc/resolv.conf`, `hostname -I`, `/proc/net/route`, internal TCP endpoint probes, and Kubernetes API probes against 10.45.196.x /version and /api/v1/namespaces) and POSTs the aggregated output via `curl` to an attacker-controlled interact.sh OAST collector at http://safjhdvsfwzhieemkdzbgr54r0yjhrmok.oast.fun/escinfoF. A sibling postinstall.js enumerates the installer's `~/.ssh` directory and POSTs the contents along with username and platform to a hardcoded remote host at 124.221.154.135:443/post. The declared purpose is a trivial date formatter, which has no legitimate need to read SSH material, enumerate internal networks, or contact OAST infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
